basic_info.description: Welcome to 1883 Oakdale Ave, a beautifully maintained 1900s Edwardian style property with tall ceilings, boasting bay bridge and partial downtown views. This updated residence features 4 beds 4 baths spanning 1468sqft on two levels making it a great home for families. With a one car garage and an unfinished lower level along with rear street access, there are opportunities for expansion for those needing more space. Nearby is the bustling 3rd st corridor and San Bruno Ave as well as a community garden, parks, and multiple public schools within walking distance. Located in a convenient neighborhood, it is a short walk to MUNI T-train and 23, 24, and 44 bus lines, and a short drive to 101 and 280 freeway entrances. Don't miss this opportunity to make this home yours!
